description: Server SDK input and response validation (M11). Each case is { name, input: { schema, value }, expected: { valid } }; `valid` is computed by the zod schema of that name in packages/protocol (UserInfo with the SDK rule that it names an account or carries userIds, AccountVerificationRequest, AnnotateRequest, EraseRequest, AssessmentResponse) or by the helper (remoteip: canonicalizeIp(x) !== null, siteKey: isSiteKey, aid: ^(assessments/)?[A-Za-z0-9_-]{42}$ matched against the whole string, a trailing newline is not part of it). A request schema is a SDK input check: an invalid value is an argument error and no request is sent; a valid one is sent as given. A response schema is judged on a 200 body: valid is a result, invalid is the error code invalid-response; unknown fields of a looseObject are kept. An empty AnnotateRequest is valid here: the SDK adds no check, and the edge answers bad-request. An empty-string remoteip or sitekey is not a case: the SDKs treat it as not given and send nothing (sdk-http.json). TransactionData is not in this file: SDKs read transaction-data.json directly. Regenerate with `pnpm --filter @revokegpt/protocol vectors:sdk-schemas`.
